name: tac-express-skillpack
description: TAC Express skill system — Violet Grid v5.0 + Fourteen Laws + GBrain enforcement layer

borrowed: skillify (10-item conformance audit, adapted from GBrain's 11-item)

skills.name: tac-express-onboarding
skills.description: MANDATORY at session start. 60-second project orientation: monorepo, design system, the 14 laws, package boundaries, and routing into specialist skills.

skills.name: tac-fourteen-laws
skills.description: MANDATORY for any code change, install, or PR review. The 14 absolute laws + forbidden-package list + remediation snippets.

skills.name: tac-karpathy-discipline
skills.description: Load before ANY non-trivial task. Think -> Simplify -> Surgical -> Goal.

skills.name: tac-skillify
skills.description: Meta skill. Turn any recurring fix or repeated workflow into a properly-skilled, tested, resolvable unit. Run when 'we keep doing X manually' or after fixing the same bug twice.

skills.name: tac-brainstorming
skills.description: MANDATORY before any new feature or component. Produces a written spec before code is written.

skills.name: tac-ui-authoring
skills.description: MANDATORY when writing or modifying any UI component. Enforces Violet Grid + CVA + packages/ui location + Radix/shadcn primitives.

skills.name: tac-design-tokens
skills.description: Load when authoring premium UI surfaces (hero, KPI cards, mission-control). Full Violet Grid v5.0 token reference.

skills.name: tac-forms
skills.description: Load when building any form. react-hook-form + zod resolver + server actions + Violet Grid field components.

skills.name: tac-accessibility
skills.description: WCAG 2.1 AA review for any UI work. Keyboard nav, focus, ARIA, Radix wiring.

skills.name: tac-data-layer
skills.description: MANDATORY when writing services, queries, hooks, or any data-fetching. Enforces UI -> packages/services -> packages/database flow.

skills.name: tac-api-surface
skills.description: Route handlers, server actions, edge functions, webhooks, rate-limited surfaces. Validation + boundary security.

skills.name: tac-supabase-schema
skills.description: Migrations, RLS policies, RPC, triggers, generated types.

skills.name: tac-auth
skills.description: Supabase auth patterns. Cookie-based SSR with @supabase/ssr.

skills.name: tac-domain-logistics
skills.description: Shipments, manifests, AWBs, scanning, invoices, rate cards, customers, exceptions, hubs.

skills.name: tac-tdd
skills.description: MANDATORY for non-trivial implementation. RED -> GREEN -> REFACTOR with Vitest + Playwright.

skills.name: tac-debug
skills.description: Use for any bug, test failure, or unexpected behavior. ALWAYS find root cause before fix. No guessing.

skills.name: tac-code-review
skills.description: Pre-merge / post-feature. Law compliance + Violet Grid adherence + architecture + code quality.

conventions.name: friction-protocol
conventions.applies_to: any request to violate a law

evals.name: routing
evals.description: Intent -> skill dispatch tests; one JSONL line per real user phrase.

checks: Every skill has valid frontmatter (name + description).
Every skill is reachable from RESOLVER.md.
No two skills share > 80% of trigger phrases (MECE).
Conventions cited by skills exist on disk.
routing.jsonl entries refer to existing skills.
